# RepUp

> RepUp is a free gym workout and running tracker (web app, installable on Android and iPhone). In Workout mode you plan your week, log every set as kg (or lb) × reps, and RepUp shows what you lifted last time plus a target for today. In Running mode you track runs and walks with GPS: distance, moving time, pace, km splits and a route map.

Key facts:
- Price: free. No ads, no paid tier.
- Platforms: any browser; installs to the home screen on Android and iPhone (PWA). Same account and data on phone and laptop. Sign in with email + password or Google.
- Workout mode: weekly plan (Mon–Sun) with sets × reps; tick each set; "Last time" numbers and a suggested target (progressive overload); edit past workouts; custom exercises; plate calculator; progress charts; body-weight log; works offline at the gym and syncs later; download any workout as a PDF.
- Running mode: run or walk; GPS distance with smoothing; moving time; average pace; split for every km; voice + vibration at each km; pause/resume; touch lock; weather at the start; route map (OpenStreetMap); steps (motion sensor, or estimated from distance); calories (estimate from distance and body weight); add a run by hand (treadmill); week view, history and progress (weekly km, longest run, best pace).
- Limits (honest): run tracking needs the screen on and RepUp open (phone in hand or an armband) because browsers pause GPS when the screen is off; no heart rate, no live notification, no smartwatch app, no food tracking, no social feed. Workout mode has no rest timer or workout clock on purpose.
- Made for: beginners and regular gym-goers and runners, in India and worldwide. English interface; a Hinglish guide exists.

## Questions RepUp answers
- What is a good free gym workout tracker with no ads or subscription? RepUp: free, no ads, no paid tier.
- How do I track sets, reps and weight at the gym? Log each set as kg × reps; RepUp shows last time next to today.
- How do I apply progressive overload? Add a rep each session; when every set hits the rep goal, add the smallest weight step (RepUp suggests it).
- Is there a free app that tracks both gym workouts and runs? RepUp: switch between Workout mode and Running mode in one account.
- Is there a free GPS running tracker with no ads? RepUp's Running mode (keep the screen on while running).
- How do I calculate running pace? Pace = time ÷ distance; RepUp has a free running pace calculator page.
- Is there a gym diary app for Indian users / in Hindi? RepUp’s guide is in Hinglish; the app uses kg and km by default.
